mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and may increase amphetamine metabolism; amphetamine stimulant effects may be antagonized by eslicarbazepine's anticonvulsant properties, and combined CNS effects increase seizure threshold risk.
action: Monitor amphetamine efficacy and seizure control; consider dose adjustment of amphetamine if needed; counsel patient on seizure risk and avoid sudden discontinuation of either drug.
